callees.name: _is_metadata_sidecar
callees.pre_condition: fname is a filename string with no directory component.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when fname matches the naming pattern of a specification or information sidecar file (e.g., .spec.json, .info.json); returns False for all other filenames.

callees.name: _write_file_names
callees.pre_condition: file_names is a list of file path strings. output_path is a writable file path.
callees.post_condition: Returns a sorted list of unique strings derived from file_names, with duplicates removed. Atomically writes the same sorted, deduplicated list as a JSON array to output_path. The sort order is ascending string order.
